key_insight: LogiKEy turns a single higher-order logic theorem prover into a classroom environment for comparing many object logics through semantic embeddings, making logic teaching interactive and pluralistic.
engineering_relevance: For computational science education, the method shows how proof assistants can unify experimentation, automated proving, and countermodel checking across classical and non-classical logics.
method: Use classical HOL as a universal metalogic.
Encode each target logic by defining its semantics inside HOL.
Teach via a staged set of puzzles and arguments that progressively expose modal, epistemic, deontic, and metaphysical logics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the approach has been used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials, including a three-year teaching reflection.
watch_item: The approach depends on carefully designed semantic embeddings, so portability and student accessibility may vary across proof assistants and logical formalisms.
paper_title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
